reading: Mode is resolved per site off the live tree (E483's resolver).  A write-mode open is not a reader: a twin whose opener set is the writer's write plus legs was never 'opened only by a leg'.  Unresolved sites are published as their own reading -- they are counted neither as reads nor as writes, so a twin whose only openers are unresolved is reported as such rather than being retired on a guess.
